title: Duper
description: A chest looking block that duplicates items put inside when powered by redstone.
body:
This mod adds a chest looking block that duplicates items you put inside it when powered by redstone. Survival friendly, crafted with 8 iron blocks and an ender chest. WARNING: This is a gag mod, do not use this on servers with economies unless you want the economy to be destroyed.
